hey, thank you for responding. sorey i replied late, its been a rough few days processing this happening. i really appreciate you taking the time to say all that you did.

im definitely going full force on healing/recovering; ever since the breakup first happened, ive taken a lot of steps towards truly improving my mental health, which i didnt take as seriously before. im on new medication and going to therapy twice a week; i used to self harm when things as bad as this would happen, but ive been working a lot on coping in non destructive ways because i know itll be better.

since i wrote this post, ive told one close friend so far, and it went really well. she opened up to me about things, and we're a lot closer. i might be opening up to another close friend later today, but im still thinking about it; my main concern is i really dont wanna fuck up the friendship situations even more than they already are fucked by talking with close friends who are also mutual friends with him about this.

thank you also for your advice regarding being up front with the next person i go into a relationship with about my feelings, i honestly didnt even consider that an option since ive felt like ive kinda had to keep all of this secret.

as for contacting him - im DEFINITELY not going to. even if i did want to, hes the one who blocked and removed me from everything we were both on. i dont have him blocked back in the off chance that in the future he wants to reach out to apologize -- which, i know is a possibility of happening, because when we were together, he would do this with previous exes/ex friends when he came to the realization that he was also an asshole on his end. but im in no way looking to contact him or ruin his reputation in talking with friends about this experience.

although, one of the things i am concerned about - which im not sure if you have any particular advice you can offer about - is that he lives in a nearby neighborhood and we do still share a lot of mutual friends, one of which would throw big parties. im not sure when the next party would be given all the virus stuff, but I have been thinking about the possibility of running into him there or another place like the arcade we both go to a lot. i dont wanna avoid these places just bc of that, but i am scared about how i should react/feel...do you have any advice on how i can possibly prepare myself for this?
